notes.title: All Hands on Deck Demo Bug fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Demo bug fixes:
Multiple bugs have been fixed regarding the use of items in online mode
- Backpack steal bug

Extendable arm fixes
- Syncing problems
- Slow player bug

Online:
- joining each other through codes fix
- Not being able to exit to main menu by joiner[/p]
